payload.title: Biblicus subprocess.run has no timeout; GROBID cold start hangs
payload.description:
Found by the Cyclotron session (read-only; refs at origin/main a35694b).

`src/papyrus_content/reference_url_text.py:2041` calls `subprocess.run` with no `timeout`. A Biblicus cold start of GROBID (docker run plus up to a 120 s readiness wait) hung a test for more than 5 minutes. The same pattern is at lines 2089 and 2124.

```gherkin
Feature: Bounded extraction subprocess
  Scenario: Biblicus child hangs
    Given the Biblicus subprocess does not exit
    When extraction runs
    Then it is killed after the configured timeout
    And a failure with a timeout reason code is returned instead of hanging
```
Acceptance: all three subprocess.run calls pass a timeout (greater than the 120 s readiness wait, configurable); TimeoutExpired becomes a structured failure; spec covers it.
